t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is better to pick yellow, orange, green and blue gnomes

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes in total and they appear in pairs yellow v red, green v pink, orange v brown and blue v pink. For the first part of the game, select the yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes until the number of mushrooms you get starts to drop. Once the numbers drop, start selecting the red, pink, brown and blue gnomes until the numbers start dropping for these, then switch back. Do this throughout the game and pick one to test at the beginning of each game, so that you can work out which team is scoring higher on each round
